text.text_excerpt: Please don't let a couple of the negative reviews here turn you away from this really neat spot!! Honestly, our group eats out a lot and have high dining expectations. We saw no evidence of their complaints. There was a full house tonight, and we still had a wonderful experience here! We were greeted warmly by the hostess and seated immediately. Our server and buster were awesome---warm and super nice, just attentive enough with perfect timing and no rushing. Great wine list and really good craft cocktails. A delightful experience with delicious food. This weekend 3 of us decided to celebrate a friend's upcoming nuptials with an early dinner. The bride-to-be selected Altamura because none of us had been there. Best decision ever! Our sever, Ron, was knowledgeable and friendly. He explained the menu, made suggestions and answered all of our questions. We started with Caesar and caprese salads. The portions were large and the caesar dressing was yummy. We ordered the king crab pasta w/ black pepper fettuccini, veal scallopini saltimboca and zuppa di pesce for entrees. All 3 were layered in flavors and the pastas had tons of protein in them. Absolutely amazing restaurant in all aspects . Came here to celebrate my birthday with a group of friends. We started our meal with the garlic bread and calamari appetizers which were both quite yummy, the garlic bread was hot out of the oven. For my entree I got the gnocchi which was absolutely delicious , the sauce that it was in was phenomenal. My fellow diners ordered the linguini with clams, shrimp pasta, and crab pasta which they all loved as well. For dessert they brought us a huge slice of chocolate cake with what I think was an espresso ice cream and a birthday candle on top. My friends who usually do not even like chocolate cake loved it!
